feature.name: Contact Enquiry
feature.description: How a visitor reaches ALFEC from the contact page, in French or English. The page shows the head-office details, a map loaded only on request, and one-tap phone and e-mail links. The project enquiry form checks every field in the browser and posts to contact/send.php. The server validates everything again, checks the optional attachment, filters automated senders invisibly (hidden field, timing token, rate limit, origin) and e-mails ALFEC. The visitor lands on a confirmation page in their language, or sees precise errors and keeps what they typed. Without JavaScript the same send ends on the confirmation or the error page. Rebuilt in September 2026.

surfaces.name: Enquiry Form
surfaces.description: Project enquiry form, posted to contact/send.php (multipart). Fieldsets Vous (name, organisation optional, role with Autre), Coordonnées (e-mail, one phone, city optional, country optional defaulting to Algeria) and Votre projet (trade optional, nature of works with Autre, activity with Autre, message, one optional attachment). A hidden field, a signed load-time token and a per-address rate limit filter automated sends without any puzzle. The browser checks every field, the server checks everything again; errors appear under each field and in a summary that links to them, and what was typed is kept.

actions.name: Send Enquiry
actions.intent: Envoyer la demande checks every field in the browser, then posts the form to contact/send.php. Errors appear under each field and in a summary (Certains champs sont à corriger avant l’envoi :) whose links move focus to the field; what was typed is kept. The server checks everything again and answers: sent (the page moves to the confirmation), field errors, too many sends, or a failure message. A hidden field or a send faster than 3 seconds after the page loaded is treated as automated: answered like a success and never e-mailed.

dependencies.name: Enquiry Endpoint
dependencies.description: Receives the multipart enquiry, validates every field and the attachment again, filters automated sends (hidden field, signed load-time token, per-address rate limit, origin check) and e-mails ALFEC in plain text with the attachment under a safe name. Answers JSON to the enhanced form and 303 redirects without JavaScript. Error details only go to the server log.

operations.name: sendEnquiry
operations.description: POST the enquiry and its optional attachment.
failureModes: 422: a field or the attachment is refused (type, MIME, content or size)
429: more than 5 accepted sends from the same address in 10 minutes
500: configuration missing or the mail server fails (logged, generic message)

assumptions: The SMTP or mail() settings and the recipient address are set at deploy time in alfec-config.php (docs/deploy.md).
Automated sends (hidden field filled, or under 3 seconds after the page loaded) are answered like a success and never e-mailed.
